answer: Keys funded by the same wallet, or signing from the same IP block, are grouped into one island. A jury panel seats at most one key per island, and an island's total grading pay is capped at one key's share, so 100 farm keys earn like one. Each epoch a prism audit splits every panel's seals by island; if an island is caught using a whisper channel to share scores before seals open, every key in it loses its 40 POA bond. Dodging the grouping means a separate funded wallet, IP and bond per key.
